title: GR180 D2 auxiliary systems 1-D sizing (fuel / oil / glycol / electrical)

basis.gas: project basis methane; Iranian city gas LHV/rho within ~5 %

injector.spec: 12 needles 2.0 x 0.2 1.4301 precision tube (ID 1.6), 10 mm into each vaporiser-stick mouth (x 17.3)

premix_stick.note: phi in the stick is far above the methane rich limit (~1.7): no flame inside the stick, it burns at the stick exit with the primary-zone air (vaporiser-stick practice); the gas jet also entrains air (ejector)

injector.feed: feed 8 x 0.5 1.4571 through the v13A M12x1 bulkhead (bore 8), 7 x 0.5 joggle inside, joins the ring at 60 deg

line_engine.spec: 1.4571 tube 15 x 1, DIN 2353 / ISO 8434-1 24 deg cone fittings (VOSS, DE); last 0.4 m DN12 stainless braided gas hose (Witzenmann, DE) to an 8/15 reducing union on the bulkhead tube

valve_proving.test: close SSV2, open SSV1 2 s, close: PT-613 must hold (SSV2 tight); vent via FCV->engine during pre-purge, then PT-613 must stay ~0 (SSV1 tight); 10 s each, every start (EN 1643 principle, burner-control logic in B1/SR1)

pressure_switch_settings.note: PSL before the regulator (supply), PSH after it (regulator failure); manual reset

gas_system.note: regulator set 3.2 barg leaves 0.3 bar to the 3.5 barg supply minimum (PSL-602 trips at 3.3); the FCV meters the flow (speed/power governor in B1), manifold pressure PT-605 is the fuel-flow observer (needles calibrated on the rig)

oil.oil: ISO VG 32 synthetic turbine oil (e.g. FUCHS Renolin / Shell Turbo S4 class; EU blender)

jet.note: 0.5 L/min per jet at 2.5 barg; for the D2R target 0.3 L/min run ~0.9 barg or use d0.6 jets (set on the rig)

pressure_pump.type: external gear pump ~1.0 cm3/rev on a 24 V BLDC motor, submerged in the tank
pressure_pump.control: speed loop on PT-701 (2.5 barg), relief 4 bar

scavenge_pump.type: gear pump ~2.5 cm3/rev, 24 V BLDC, on the tank lid, suction from the drain collector

tank.note: baffle, sight glass, float LSL-707, TE-704, drain

filter.rating: 10 um, beta10 >= 200, bypass 2.5 bar, electrical clogging switch PDS-703

cooler.type: oil-to-glycol tube cooler (Laminova C43 class, SE)

breather.separator: coalescing oil-mist separator >= 30 m3/h, drain to the scavenge collector, vent outside the enclosure

core_vent.passage: one tube 5 x 0.5 (ID 4) in the re-drilled 272 deg diffuser land (Ø5.2 in a 9.2 mm land)
core_vent.verdict: NOT OK with the D2R labyrinths (6 g/s): the chamber would pressurise and stop the buffer flow. D2R must cut the core seal air to <= ~1 g/s (turbo piston rings / carbon ring on the d14 runner and the compressor boss) or open a vent passage of >= ~90 mm2 (not possible through one diffuser land)

glycol.fluid: 40 % inhibited propylene glycol (Clariant Antifrogen L class)
glycol.order: pump -> PMG jacket (coldest) -> oil cooler -> radiator -> expansion tank / pump suction

pump.type: wet-rotor circulator with PWM input (Grundfos UPM3 FLEX AS 15-75 130 class, DK), 230 V

radiator.fan: 305 mm 24 V axial fan, brushless PWM (SPAL class, IT), 30-150 W

glycol.note: supply 38-39 C at the 30 C site (PMG design 35-40 C); 54-55 C at 46 C roof air: stator/magnet run ~15 K warmer (Sm2Co17 OK, EMF -0.5 %); connect to the plant glycol loop (DC-1/HX-4) later if wanted

electrical.note: cycle P_net already subtracts 0.6 kW aux (d2r_turbine.json cycle_basis): the D2A load fits
